gloss: anman; steamed bun with sweet red bean filling

definitions.gloss: steamed bun filled with sweet red bean paste
definitions.explanation: A soft white steamed bun with a sweet {餡|あん} (red bean paste) filling. Sold hot at convenience stores in winter alongside the savory {肉|にく}まん.

examples.japanese: あんまんを{一|ひと}つください。
{寒|さむ}い{日|ひ}はあんまんが{食|た}べたくなる。
examples.english: On cold days I start wanting an anman.

examples.japanese: コンビニであんまんと{肉|にく}まんを{一|ひと}つずつ{買|か}って{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: I bought one anman and one nikuman at the convenience store and headed home.

notes:
Composed of {餡|あん} (sweet bean paste) + まん, a shortening of {饅頭|まんじゅう}. Usually written in kana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あんまんを{蒸|む}す: to steam an anman
- {温|あたた}かいあんまん: a warm anman
- あんまん{一|ひと}つ: one anman (ordering at a counter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肉|にく}まん: steamed pork bun — the savory counterpart, sold side by side
- {中華|ちゅうか}まん: Chinese-style steamed bun — the category term covering both
- {饅頭|まんじゅう}: manju — a broader class of bean-filled confections, not necessarily steamed hot for eating on the spot
